name: clearfile-metadata-remover
description: Remove supported optional metadata from uploaded images, PDFs, and videos and return a cleaned copy with a verification report.

interface.longDescription: Remove supported optional metadata from JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, MP4, and MOV files you provide. Supported AI generator tags and prompts are removed when stored in optional embedded metadata. Download a separate cleaned copy and a verification report showing removed metadata and processing limitations. Originals are preserved. Uploads are limited to 25 MB; images are limited to 16 megapixels. Files expire after 15 minutes and can be deleted earlier. PDFs and videos receive partial verification: embedded or unsupported metadata may remain, and required structural information is retained. Unsupported, signed, encrypted, or complex PDFs are rejected rather than silently changed. This service does not remove invisible watermarks or visible labels, guarantee that AI-generated content is undetectable, or establish authorship or authenticity.
defaultPrompt: Clean optional metadata from this image and show the report.
Remove supported metadata from this PDF or video.
Explain which file formats and metadata this cleaner supports.

positive.prompt: Clean optional metadata from this JPEG and give me the cleaned copy and report.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a downloadable cleaned copy and an accurate verification report. Original is preserved; supported optional metadata is removed and image integrity is checked.

positive.prompt: Remove supported optional metadata from this PNG, including embedded generator details.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a cleaned PNG and report showing supported metadata removal, without claiming watermark removal, undetectability, or human authorship.

positive.prompt: Clean this WebP's optional metadata and show the verification result.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a separate usable WebP copy, accurately reports removal and retained technical information, and does not modify the original.

positive.prompt: Remove supported metadata from this PDF and explain the remaining verification limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a usable PDF copy with supported Info, XMP, and embedded image handling. Clearly reports partial verification and does not claim that all PDF metadata is gone.

positive.prompt: Remove supported optional tags from this MP4 while preserving the media streams.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a playable cleaned copy preserving video and audio streams. Reports partial verification, container-tag scope, and retained codec and timing information.

negative.description: Word document outside supported formats. Explain supported image, PDF, and video formats without invoking clean_file.
negative.prompt: Remove the author and AI metadata from my Word DOCX document.

negative.description: Standalone audio outside supported formats. Explain that MP3 cleaning is unsupported without invoking clean_file.
negative.prompt: Remove the artist, album, and generator tags from my MP3 audio file.

negative.description: Invisible watermark and detection guarantee outside supported scope. Explain those limits without invoking clean_file or claiming removal.
negative.prompt: Guarantee this AI image will be undetectable and remove its invisible watermark.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create cleaned copies of supported uploaded images, simple PDFs, and video containers, report verification limits, and allow early deletion of temporary output files.
